title: Good idea and concept but…
body: This is app would be great but unfortunately the restaurants absolutely hate it. One time i put my reservation to, I sodi (a popular, very hard to get into NYC restaurant) and someone claimed it. A couple months later i had another reservation at, I sodi which I planned on going to but they texted me that my reservation was cancelled because I used a 3 party to give my reservation to previously. So long story short the app is great until you can no longer go to your favorite restaurants.

title: Please
body: Formal request to not notify us that our reservation has been picked up until AFTER the initial 5 minutes has passed. Please!!!!! Also, the app should be more clear about who currently is responsible for potential cancellation fees, as someone held my res for 30+ minutes but when they dropped it still showed under my reservations; I feel like after 30 mins it should move to that persons account. But overall this is a great app and customer service (Miranda) is so quick to respond and so helpful!!!!! Just could use some improvements

title: Idea is there, functionality is not
body: Great App with plenty of uses, however, I’ve given up a few reservations through ResX and I feel they could do a better job protecting those who offer quality reservations. Of the reservations I gave, they happen to be because either I couldn’t make it or some other plans came up. I submitted these reservations a few days in advance and they were all claimed, or so I thought. Of those, after being claimed for basically a whole day, some of them were canceled within hours or minutes of the reservation when I had this booked for days and the restaurant would see my name if the person who “claimed” it doesn’t show up. This isn’t fair to someone that is trying to help out the community. I’d rather keep good standing with these restaurants and cancel right away than have to deal with random people canceling on my behalf last minute. Hoping this issue is fixed in the future.
